stagingDiagnosticResidue.reason: RP-108 (2026-09-07): temporary diagnostic slugs left on staging by the 2026-08-30 VTO provider benchmark. They have no source in this tree and never did, so they are not governed here — but they WERE deployed on staging and this file did not name them, which meant a read of it under-counted the live surface by three. Recorded so a fresh clone can account for every slug staging actually carries. vto-provider-diag is documented in docs/vto-provider-benchmark.md §3.7, where it was redeployed as an inert 410 stub; rapidapi-key-diag and rapidapi-current-audit were undocumented anywhere in the repository before this entry.
stagingDiagnosticResidue.posture: vto-provider-diag: verify_jwt=true. rapidapi-key-diag and rapidapi-current-audit: verify_jwt=false, i.e. invokable without a caller JWT. All three were read from the Management API read-only during RP-108; none was invoked, redeployed or deleted by that lane.
stagingDiagnosticResidue.ownerAction: Remove all three slugs from staging (yzqjvdfgefveprobvvyw). This is an owner action: RP-108 has no authority to delete Edge Functions, and the Supabase MCP surface exposes no delete_edge_function tool. They are absent from production.
